# Evaluation results

Run 2026-11-10T17:39:02+00:00 on `evaluation/dataset_v2_holdout.json` v2: 20 synthetic reports (see `evaluation/RESULTS.md` for what each run means).

**Read this first:** all speech is generated by Gnani Timbre, not spoken by people. The noisy condition adds synthetic factory noise at 10 dB SNR. These numbers show how the pipeline behaves on clear and noisy machine speech. They are not accuracy on real technicians, accents or phone microphones, and not pilot results.

Conditions: **text** = reference text typed in (rules only, no speech recognition) · **clean** = Timbre audio through real Prisma and the full pipeline · **noisy** = the same audio with noise.

## Field accuracy

| Field | text | clean | noisy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Equipment (register match) | 100% (20/20) | 95% (19/20) | 100% (20/20) |
| Symptoms, exact set | 70% (14/20) | 70% (14/20) | 70% (14/20) |
| Symptoms, lenient | 70% (14/20) | 70% (14/20) | 70% (14/20) |
| Production impact | 70% (14/20) | 65% (13/20) | 70% (14/20) |

| Category | 100% (20/20) | 100% (20/20) | 100% (20/20) |
| Next action | 60% (12/20) | 60% (12/20) | 60% (12/20) |
| Priority (policy on true fields) | 75% (15/20) | 75% (15/20) | 70% (14/20) |
| **Whole report correct** | 45% (9/20) | 45% (9/20) | 45% (9/20) |

Symptom precision / recall (micro, exact keys):

- text: precision 0.95, recall 0.79 (tp 19, fp 1, fn 5)
- clean: precision 0.95, recall 0.79 (tp 19, fp 1, fn 5)
- noisy: precision 0.95, recall 0.75 (tp 18, fp 1, fn 6)

Requests that failed: 0

## Outcome of each report

- **correct**: the preview is right and ready to send.
- **asked**: the app asked a follow-up question or for the machine; the technician answers and the report completes (recoverable).
- **wrong, not asked**: the app offered a preview with a wrong field, which the technician would have to notice in the preview.

| Condition | correct | asked | wrong, not asked | of which safety missed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| text | 9 | 9 | 2 | 1 |
| clean | 9 | 9 | 2 | 1 |
| noisy | 9 | 9 | 2 | 1 |

## Speech recognition (Prisma)

Word and character error rate of the transcript against the text Timbre was given (lower case, punctuation removed). For Hindi and Telugu, Prisma may write English loanwords or numbers in another script than the reference, which counts as an error here even when the meaning is intact.

| Language | WER clean | WER noisy | CER clean | CER noisy | Auto language detection | Median latency clean |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| English | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 100% (5/5) | 0.31 s |
| Hinglish | 0.10 | 0.05 | 0.04 | 0.02 | 0% (0/5) | 0.31 s |
| Hindi | 0.27 | 0.33 | 0.30 | 0.41 | 100% (5/5) | 0.27 s |
| Telugu | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 100% (5/5) | 0.32 s |

WER / CER are medians per language. Latency is the whole `/voice/process-report` request (upload, Prisma, extraction, database lookups) measured in-process; Timbre is off (`speak=false`).
Auto detection expects en-IN for Hinglish (Latin-script output is what the app uses for Hinglish).
